answer: From a modern perspective, gender roles have mostly disappeared; in almost every country both men and women are now allowed to do exactly what they want, including household chores, leadership positions, and parenting roles, and there is very little meaningful difference between the two. Because of this freedom, traditional beliefs such as fatherhood as the primary breadwinner or motherhood as the central role are largely obsolete today.
